s1.syndrome_frame: Abdominal mass with variable growth pattern in a patient with history of plasma cell myeloma
salient_findings: 35 mm lesion in the right hepatic lobe with SUVmax of 6.1 on PET/CT
17 mm lesion in segment VI with moderately increased T2 signal and restricted diffusion on MRI
Lesion size decreased to 10 mm then enlarged to 57 × 46 mm on serial imaging
key_facts: Patient has IgG kappa plasma cell myeloma
Patient has undergone multiple chemotherapy regimens
Patient has undergone two autologous stem-cell transplants
Patient has undergone thalidomide maintenance and focal bone radiotherapy
Patient is asymptomatic with stable vital signs
No hepatosplenomegaly on examination
Liver function tests are within normal limits
PET/CT showed a 35 mm lesion in the right hepatic lobe with SUVmax of 6.1
MRI showed a 17 mm lesion in segment VI with moderately increased T2 signal and restricted diffusion
Lesion size decreased then enlarged on serial imaging
Percutaneous liver biopsy was planned to establish a definitive diagnosis

shortlist.why_kept: Patient has history of IgG kappa plasma cell myeloma and lesion in liver

shortlist.label: Extramedullary plasmacytoma
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has history of plasma cell myeloma and abnormal liver lesion

shortlist.label: Primary hepatic lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Abnormal liver lesion and patient's history of immunosuppression

raw.rationale: The patient's history of IgG kappa plasma cell myeloma and the presence of a liver lesion with increased SUVmax on PET/CT and characteristic MRI findings suggest hepatic involvement of the underlying myeloma.

rejected.label: Extramedullary plasmacytoma
rejected.why: While possible, the presence of a single liver lesion without other evidence of extramedullary disease makes this less likely.

rejected.label: Hepatocellular carcinoma
rejected.why: Normal liver function tests and the absence of hepatosplenomegaly make primary liver malignancy less likely.

rejected.label: Metastatic disease
rejected.why: The patient's history of myeloma and the characteristics of the liver lesion make metastatic disease from another primary less likely.

rejected.label: Lymphoma
rejected.why: The patient's history and the specific characteristics of the liver lesion do not strongly support a diagnosis of lymphoma.

rejected.label: Hepatic amyloidosis
rejected.why: There is no mention of systemic symptoms or other findings suggestive of amyloidosis.

rejected.label: Intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
rejected.why: The imaging characteristics and the patient's history do not specifically support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Primary hepatic lymphoma
rejected.why: The patient's history and the specific characteristics of the liver lesion do not strongly support a diagnosis of primary hepatic lymphoma.
